review.description: The layered registries map new production actions, YAML definitions, worker sources and actual new assertions while preserving stable flow/entity IDs and the pinned historical adoption policy.
review.implementation: Reviewed generated-section ownership and behavior-to-UI-to-glossary direction. Reconciliation records are produced only by the CLI after declared suites pass; no receipts are edited by hand and no adoption entries are extended. Preserved PR22 contributor guidance and its final coordinator handoff; selected main and merge base are the exact actual target, and final committed freshness is checked with --head HEAD after receipt integration.
review.tests: Render and validate accept the complete candidate registries. The mandatory tooling suite checks schema, source/assertion mappings, fixture execution, receipt fingerprints and immutable historical adoption policy for this full branch comparison.
